ceramic.snippet:
WDW resorts to start charging for parking Login to post comments 29 posts / 0 new Wed, 03/14/2018 - 17:28 wdwizbest Offline Joined: 02/03/2017 Posts: 307 WDW resorts to start charging for parking 

  wdwizbest wrote:  $13/day budget, $19.00/day moderate, an $24.00/day deluxe. Thoughts? 

  1) I think that this is a new way that Disney it trying to direct and control the flow of people on property. I think that we can expect a percentage drop in people who rent cars with this, and maybe even drive; therefore more people will be using the Disney transportation options, which give Disney more control.

 Wed, 03/14/2018 - 18:58 wdwizbest Offline Joined: 02/03/2017 Posts: 307 

  wdwizbest wrote:  I love WDW but it's this sort of thing that is increasingly taking the \"magic\" out of trips to WDW. 

 Thu, 03/15/2018 - 12:00 wdwizbest Offline Joined: 02/03/2017 Posts: 307
